vocabulary.definition: to fill or soak completely with a substance
vocabulary.example: The market is saturating with new smartphone models every month.

vocabulary.definition: to capture the whole attention of someone; to fascinate
vocabulary.example: The magician's performance seemed to hypnotize the audience.

vocabulary.definition: lacking character or originality; showing no soul
vocabulary.example: The movie was criticized for its soullessly predictable plot.

vocabulary.definition: in a way that cannot be changed back to how things were before
vocabulary.example: The decision to shut down the factory will irreversibly impact the local economy.

vocabulary.definition: with a feeling or belief that one can rely on something; assuredly
vocabulary.example: She confidently presented her research findings to the board.

vocabulary.definition: causing harm or destruction, especially gradually or subtly
vocabulary.example: The corrosive effects of gossip can damage relationships.
